subject.title: Feature discussion: model-centric token / cost view across providers

question: Should CodexBar first add a provider-safe Models view, add provider-local top-model lines, or commit now to canonical cross-provider aggregation?
rationale: The code already supports provider-local model details, but choosing the new surface and deciding when identities and costs may cross provider boundaries are product and data-contract decisions rather than mechanical implementation choices.

options.title: Stage a Models view
options.body: Add a separate provider-qualified Models view first, merging rows only when canonical identity is authoritative and keeping costs separated by provider and currency.

options.title: Start with card summaries
options.body: Show top models within each provider card without cross-provider aggregation, accepting additional Overview density until compact mode is resolved.

options.title: Build full aggregation now
options.body: Define canonical aliases, cost/currency policy, exclusions, and double-counting provenance before exposing combined model totals and settings.

recommendation.title: Stage a Models view
recommendation.body: Add a separate provider-qualified Models view first, merging rows only when canonical identity is authoritative and keeping costs separated by provider and currency.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ownership of the model-breakdown UI and repository-level product authority make this the best available routing candidate.
